remarks:
Welcome to a truly one-of-a-kind sanctuary in the heart of the village of Westfield and only a few minutes from Lake Erie. Offering the rare luxury of eight private, peaceful acres, this exceptional property delivers authentic country charm combined with the convenience of village living. Originally built in 1820 and completely rebuilt in 1960, this historic colonial house seamlessly blends classic character with comfortable living.

The home features a formal dining room perfect for hosting, alongside a large, comfortable living room anchored by a cozy wood-burning fireplace. A bright and airy sunroom is highlighted with a dramatic cathedral ceiling and offers sweeping, scenic views of the surrounding natural landscape—an ideal spot to unwind year-round.

Upstairs you'll find three generous bedrooms each offering plenty of closet space, providing ample storage for every season. The primary retreat features a dedicated, separate dressing room for an added touch of luxury and organization.

Inside you'll also find a large attic space with massive room for extra storage or potential conversion into custom living space, plus a functional laundry area located in the basement.

Outside you'll find eight picturesque acres complete with a serene private pond, mature trees, and lush landscaping that attract an abundance of local wildlife. The property borders Chautauqua Gorge which allows you to enjoy direct proximity to one of the region's most breathtaking natural features, right from your back yard. There's also two full-sized barns with generous capacity throughout, including one barn equipped with horse stalls—ideal for equestrian lovers, hobbyists, or those seeking abundant storage space. There's also another smaller, versatile outbuilding which can provide convenient extra space for gardening tools, workshops, or seasonal gear.

This property is more than just a house, it’s a place to relax, recharge, and truly feel at home. Experience the very best of peaceful country living while remaining just minutes from Westfield’s local shops, dining, schools, and vibrant lake activities.
